verdict.rationale: Stagehand has a dedicated user-data best-practices page. It documents a persistent user data directory that survives browser shutdown, so the next run starts from the same cookies and local storage. For Browserbase sessions, it documents contexts for persisting browser data, which together cover reusable logged-in state across runs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that agents actually skip login walls, and deeper documentation of managing multiple named profiles or context lifecycle and expiry.
